acceptance_criteria: The operator selects one GitHub-rooted Build Order without mixing multiple epic graphs
GitHub membership, metadata, lifecycle, and native blockers remain authoritative
Aiur activity joins with explicit provenance and never clears GitHub dependencies
The graph remains truthful through provider failure, cycles, external blockers, and missing activity
The route is authenticated, read-only, accessible, responsive, and usable through 100 members
Ticket context exposes safe GitHub and bidirectional dependency navigation
required_documentation: Build Order metadata and GitHub relationship authoring guide
Provider health, freshness, and troubleshooting guide
Operator route and graph interaction guide
required_cleanup: Remove duplicate AgentList activity ownership after migration
Remove temporary acceptance fixtures and compatibility code explicitly owned by this feature
end_to_end_proof: Published native GitHub Build Order graph exercised through the real Aiur CLI and authenticated dashboard
Keyboard, touch, light, dark, reduced-motion, degraded-provider, and 20/50/100-member evidence
feature_boundary.completion_condition: All eleven tickets are implemented and reviewed, current-base green, merged, documented, cleaned up, and proven through the required real CLI and browser workflow; companion and deferred work cannot extend completion.

external_gates.title: Confirm same-repository read-only v1
external_gates.resolution_criteria: Confirm or revise the planning default before implementation tickets are dispatched.

decisions.summary: Split GitHub planning truth from Aiur runtime activity
decisions.rationale: Each system already owns different facts and neither may overwrite the other.

decisions.summary: Use labeled root issues and direct native sub-issues
decisions.rationale: This gives stable selectable membership without per-feature labels or a second database.

decisions.summary: Use native blockedBy as the only hard dependency truth
decisions.rationale: Native relationships prevent prose drift and preserve outcome semantics.

decisions.summary: Keep phase lane and complexity metadata strict and single-valued
decisions.rationale: Ambiguity must remain visible rather than silently choose a planning value.

decisions.summary: Publish only complete atomic last-known-good graph generations
decisions.rationale: Partial provider responses must never make dependencies disappear.

decisions.summary: Move shared activity ownership out of AgentList
decisions.rationale: Headless dashboard consumers need one daemon-owned projection rather than a UI-owned fold.

decisions.summary: Use accessible DOM cards with a vendored layout-only worker
decisions.rationale: ELK.js can compute directed layered geometry while Aiur retains semantic rendering and product state.

decisions.summary: Keep Build Order read-only in v1
decisions.rationale: GitHub remains authoritative and editing requires a separate secure mutation design.

decisions.summary: Keep dashboard catch-up and accounting outside Build Order
decisions.rationale: Companion presentation and financial work must not alter the finite Build Order terminal condition.

decisions.summary: Treat phase as presentation and rollout guidance only
decisions.rationale: Readiness comes from dependencies, outcomes, health, conflicts, and capacity.

requirements.summary: Select one stable GitHub-rooted Build Order from multiple roots
Use direct sub-issue membership and strict planning metadata
Use native blocker relationships and completed-only satisfaction
Publish only complete bounded GitHub provider generations
Expose shared headless-safe typed Aiur ticket activity
Join GitHub plan and Aiur activity without I/O or guessed defaults
Provide URL-backed selection and explicit provider states
Render arbitrary lane-by-phase cards with truthful metadata
Render honest edges, cycles, external references, and diagnostics
Support complete pan, zoom, selection, input, and motion parity
Provide reusable accessible ticket and dependency context
Prove bounded provider and browser behavior through 100 members
Preserve authenticated read-only and privacy boundaries
Own documentation, cleanup, merged-base and real-workflow acceptance

tickets.title: Define Build Order domain contract
tickets.outcome: Aiur has a strict pure contract for GitHub-rooted Build Orders, metadata, outcomes, dependencies, and readiness.
scope: Define strict root/member/identity records and total bounded parsers
Define metadata, lifecycle, edge-satisfaction, and phase policies
non_goals: Fetch providers or render UI
Support Linear, cross-repository, nested, or editable orders
tickets.complexity_rationale: One new strict domain contract and parser boundary

agent_gate: Pure tests cover all valid, invalid, missing, duplicate, terminal, cyclic, and bounded parser cases
at_merge_gate: Current-base compile, lint, focused tests, and CI pass

tickets.title: Fetch complete GitHub Build Order graphs
tickets.outcome: A bounded adapter returns complete root catalogs and selected-root candidate graphs or a structured failure.
scope: Fetch catalogs, direct sub-issues, identities, labels, outcomes, and paginated blockers
Preserve external blockers and prove bounded calls at 20, 50, and 100 members
non_goals: Cache generations or poll per browser
Write GitHub relationships or labels
tickets.complexity_rationale: Batched paginated GitHub graph reads with partial-failure semantics

agent_gate: Adapter tests cover pagination, partial errors, external blockers, outcomes, limits, and call bounds
at_merge_gate: Current GitHub schema is rechecked and current-base CI passes

tickets.title: Project atomic last-known-good graphs
tickets.outcome: The daemon exposes independently healthy catalog and selected-order LKG snapshots with bounded demand-driven refresh.
scope: Supervise separate catalog and selected-root generations
Coalesce demand, bound polling/eviction, publish health and freshness
non_goals: Parse GitHub or render UI
Poll every root or browser independently
tickets.complexity_rationale: Supervised dual-cache lifecycle and GitHub budget integration

agent_gate: Process tests cover LKG, failure, recovery, coalescing, eviction, restart, and browser-independent calls
at_merge_gate: Supervision tests and current-base CI pass with documented poll budget

tickets.title: Project shared ticket activity
tickets.outcome: Aiur exposes headless-safe typed ticket activity with state, progress provenance, stage, backend/model, tokens, evidence, and staleness.
scope: Build canonical pure reducers and always-supervised activity projection
Retain all relevant lifecycle states with bounded policy and explicit restart unknowns
non_goals: Migrate AgentList consumers
Fetch GitHub, persist billing, or parse logs in LiveView
tickets.complexity_rationale: New always-supervised reducer across runtime event sources

agent_gate: Reducer/process tests cover headless mode, every lifecycle, duplicates, typed identity, retention, and restart
at_merge_gate: Existing event/AgentList suites and current-base CI pass

tickets.title: Migrate AgentList to shared activity
tickets.outcome: AgentList consumes shared activity without losing event, debug ticker, roster, progress, phase, or snapshot behavior.
scope: Characterize current AgentList activity semantics
Migrate canonical facts while retaining view-specific rendering and debug rows
non_goals: Redesign TUI or change activity semantics
Implement Build Order UI
tickets.complexity_rationale: Characterize and convert one existing UI consumer

agent_gate: Characterization and migration tests cover progress, stage, debug events, pruning, and no double counting
at_merge_gate: Interactive/headless suites and current-base CI pass

tickets.title: Join planning and runtime state
tickets.outcome: A pure presenter returns truthful cards, edges, adjacency, readiness, diagnostics, ordering, counts, and freshness.
scope: Join GitHub and activity snapshots on typed identity
Derive edge/status/readiness precedence, cycles, external references, and lane/phase groups
non_goals: Fetch, mutate, lay out, or render
Hide invalid or unknown graph facts
tickets.complexity_rationale: Pure presenter and graph diagnostics over two snapshots

agent_gate: Pure tests cover absent/stale activity, every outcome, external/missing blockers, cycles, and arbitrary phases
at_merge_gate: Current-base pure suites and CI pass

tickets.title: Integrate accessible graph layout platform
tickets.outcome: A pinned local worker computes layout geometry and routed edges while cards remain semantic server-rendered DOM.
scope: Vendor pinned ELK.js and license with authenticated static serving
Implement generation-safe worker/hook adapter and prove 20/50/100 fixtures
non_goals: Render the route or own graph semantics
Use CDN, canvas-only nodes, or prototype coordinates
tickets.complexity_rationale: New vendored browser worker and LiveView layout adapter

agent_gate: Asset, worker, generation, redraw, fallback, semantic DOM, and 20/50/100 tests pass
at_merge_gate: Browser performance evidence and current-base CI pass
human_or_e2e: Reviewer inspects representative layouts and fallback

tickets.title: Build reusable ticket context
tickets.outcome: A reusable accessible ticket surface shows all-state facts, safe GitHub/actions, and navigable dependency context without provider reads.
scope: Render normalized ticket, activity, dependency, health, and action context
Support dependency replacement navigation and complete dialog focus behavior
non_goals: Fetch synchronously or edit dependencies
Hard-code repository or drop external endpoints
tickets.complexity_rationale: Shared all-state ticket detail component and interaction contract

agent_gate: Component/browser tests cover every lifecycle, relationship diagnostic, safe action, and focus flow
at_merge_gate: Shared dashboard suites and current-base CI pass
human_or_e2e: Reviewer verifies running, completed, and external contexts by keyboard

tickets.title: Ship selectable minimum graph
tickets.outcome: Authenticated URL-backed routes render a selected read-only Build Order graph with provider states, diagnostics, cards, edges, and ticket context.
scope: Add catalog and selected-root routes with deterministic canonical deep links
Integrate graph/activity view model, layout, context, navigation, and all degraded states
non_goals: Edit GitHub or implement companion dashboard work

agent_gate: LiveView tests cover selection/deep links, every provider state, auth/read-only, graph diagnostics, and context

Prove accessibility, redraw correctness, responsive behavior, and explicit performance budgets

agent_gate: Browser/a11y/performance tests cover all input, patch, theme, motion, viewport, and 20/50/100 cases
